description: Core enemy archetypes (Phase 1 simplification). 18 archetypes defined in enemies-core.json. Deleted legacy types migrated to archetype + ability combos.

migration.berserker: removed — normal + berserk buff (wave buff injection)
migration.regenerator: removed — tank + regen buff (wave buff injection)
migration.elite: removed — tank + armorBuff via wave scaling
migration.mirror: renamed to summoner (id=summoner, sprite=mirror) — deathSpawn ability
migration.devoter: renamed to drainer (id=drainer, sprite=devoter) — strengthDrain ability
migration.reflector: renamed to shielder (id=shielder, sprite=shielded) — projectileBlock ability
migration.timewarp: removed — purifier (id=purifier) with purge ability covers this role
migration.ironhide: renamed to ironwill (id=ironwill, sprite=ironwill) — ccImmune ability
migration.stealth: renamed to phantom (id=phantom, sprite=stealth) — evasion ability (not stealth behavior)
migration.teleporter: renamed to phaser (id=phaser, sprite=teleporter) — phaseShift ability

spriteIdMismatch._note: Some archetypes reuse legacy sprite names. These are NOT bugs but historical naming.
